title: Speed of Sound in a Gas
learningObjectives: Explain that Mach number is the ratio of gas speed to the speed of sound in the gas.
Calculate speed of sound from specific heat ratio, gas constant, and absolute temperature.
Explain why density change is small and compressibility can be ignored at low subsonic speeds.

evidence.quote: The Mach number is the ratio of the speed of the aircraft, or the speed of the gas, to the speed of sound in the gas.

explanations.text: Mach number compares the speed of the aircraft or gas to the local speed of sound.
